data.name: So Stoked
data.detailed_description:
So Stoked is a chill and cozy 2D surf adventure focused on timing, flow, and exploration. Ride gentle waves, travel between islands, and enjoy a relaxed experience where progression is driven by curiosity rather than pressure.

Surf at your own pace as you explore hand-crafted pixel-art islands, meet friendly locals, and take on light tasks that gradually unlock new boards and areas. There is no rush. No punishment for experimenting. Just smooth movement, calm vibes, and satisfying progression.

Designed as a feel-good experience, So Stoked blends cozy life-sim elements with exploration and light RPG-style progression. Whether you play for five minutes or an hour, it is easy to pick up, unwind, and simply enjoy the ride.

Features

  • Relaxing, skill-based surfing built around timing and flow

  • Explore charming pixel-art islands at your own pace

  • Light RPG-style tasks and progression without grind

  • Unlock surfboards and upgrades through play

  • Cozy, family-friendly atmosphere with no high-pressure systems

  • Top-down 2D pixel art visuals with a colourful, stylised look

  • Designed for short sessions or longer laid-back play

A Cozy Surf Experience

So Stoked is not about competition or perfect scores. It is about mood, movement, and discovery. A game to unwind with, explore freely, and enjoy the simple joy of riding waves in a calm, welcoming world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.4 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics compatible with DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on low-end PCs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on low-end PCs.
